data.name: Abhishek Patil
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Abhishek Patil has made a big mark in cricket. With 51 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 58*, with an average of 19.13 and a quick strike rate of 176.80. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 39 sixes and 58 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 25.3 overs, taking 11 wickets at an economy rate of 13.96. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
